title: First source-bound coupled EM candidate: Branch-A fluxonium with one passive readout mode (S1), declared inside the V2A five-node proposal
status: CHECKPOINT-A-PROPOSED; not approved for execution; every ENGINEERING-SEED below is unapproved

frame.origin: centre of the top surface of the chip substrate (spec §7.3)
frame.axes: +X/+Y chip plane, +Z from chip toward lid

proposed_structure.name: v2a_five_node_hypothesis
proposed_structure.description: Two grounded Branch-A encoded fluxoniums F1, F2; one SQUID-transmon mediator C; two passive readout modes R1, R2. Described in the received V2A assessment; its parameters are absent from every source package in this repository.
proposed_structure.ground: chip ground plane, continuous with the Object 001 package floor

binding.note: value bound; the EXISTENCE of a second device in this circuit is proposed by the V2A assessment only

binding.needed_from: the V2A audit's own artefacts (five-node capacitance matrix, frozen Hamiltonian file); no seed is proposed because reconstructing E_J, E_C from the reported f_22 would be a reconstruction from a summary

binding.locator: L85 (production dressed logical-blind root, the bare w_r of the dressed Hamiltonian L75)

binding.needed_from: no source states R2; only '>= 10 MHz same-feedline separation' (Full Edition L361-364)

interactions.quantity: g_F1R1 = 8 E_C,F1R1 n_zpf,R1 (Master convention g n (a + a^dag))

proposed_structure.why_not_executable: C.squid and R2.resonator are UNBOUND, every coupling geometry is UNBOUND, and no source package supplies them. The full structure cannot be a source-bound candidate.

executable_scope.name: S1_branchA_fluxonium_plus_readout
executable_scope.represents: a bounded subsystem of the proposed structure: one grounded Branch-A encoded fluxonium capacitively coupled to one passive readout mode, in a bounded chip cell of the Object 001 package
executable_scope.claims: numerical extraction of E_C,F1F1, E_C,F1R1, (E_C,R1R1, E_L,R1) and hence g_F1R1 by two independent routes for the declared seed geometry; agreement of the routes to the 10 % ENGINEERING-RULE; suitability report against the source-bound E_C, w_r, g
does_not_claim: any statement about the mediator, F2, R2 or their couplings
that the seed geometry is the Branch-A device (that is the suitability report, not a claim)
hardware performance, Purcell, kappa, gate physics

geometry.rationale: the full 22 x 22 x 1.5 mm Object 001 cavity with 30-40 um chip features exceeds the runner DOF budget; the cell keeps the source-seeded vertical structure (chip thickness, lid height) and bounds the lateral extent; the wall effect is measured by the box-size ladder of the numerical plan and is an omitted effect, not a route disagreement

lateral_4mm.rationale: smallest cell that holds the island, the coupling region and a 7 mm quarter-wave meander with >= 0.5 mm clearance to the walls

ground_plane.surface: z = 0, whole cell top surface except the etched features below

binding.rationale: metallisation thickness is not stated by any source; zero-thickness PEC is the Palace cpw-example model

square island sized so that its coplanar capacitance to ground lands near the source-bound C_Sigma = 32.28 fF (E_C = 0.60 GHz); scaling from typical fluxonium islands; the realised C_Sigma is the suitability quantity, not a design guarantee

features.spans: the -Y gap between F1.island and ground

binding.rationale: the junction and superinductor occupy the same node-to-ground gap; one rectangular site of 20 um across the 40 um gap

open-end pad of the resonator facing the island's +X edge across a 20 um gap; the coupling capacitance it realises sets g_F1R1 and is reported against the source-bound 0.150 GHz as suitability, not tuned

features.path: from R1.coupling_pad along +X, then a meander of 1.0 mm legs along Y with 0.25 mm pitch inside x in [-0.30, 1.50], y in [-0.75, 0.75], ending in a short to ground

binding.rationale: quarter-wave line at the source-bound bare readout frequency 4.301974466 GHz with eps_eff = (1 + eps_r)/2 = 6.225: lambda/4 = 6.983 mm; 50/30 um CPW is a conventional ~50 Ohm geometry on silicon (the Palace cpw example uses 56 Ohm)
no source names the substrate; isotropic silicon eps_r = 11.45 (cryogenic) is proposed; sapphire (anisotropic 9.4/11.5) is the alternative and is NOT chosen here
no source names the superconductor; kinetic inductance omitted (see physical_effects)

boundary_conditions.surface: all six outer faces of the cell
boundary_conditions.note: top face = lid at the Object 001 height above chip; bottom face = package recess floor under the chip; lateral faces are artificial walls of the bounded cell (omitted effect)

boundary_conditions.condition: lumped ports as declared; Route A: F1 site inductive, R1 tap absent; Route B: both resistive

electrical_nodes.ground_connection: galvanic short at the meander end

binding.rationale: no source states C_J; 0 fF means all of C_Sigma is geometric; any later nonzero value is added ONCE to E_C after extraction (coupling-definition §8.4)

lumped_elements_S1.derived_from: E_C = e^2 / (2 C_Sigma) with E_C = 0.60 GHz

analytic_seed_values.note: derived from source-bound energies and the seed eps_r by the formulas in coupling-definition.md; not evidence

readout_lumped_equivalent_at_50_ohm.note: lumped LC equivalent of a 50 ohm line at the source-bound bare root; used only to size the seed, never as an input

coupling_capacitance_implied_by_the_sour.formula: g = 8 E_C,F1R1 n_zpf,R with n_zpf,R = (E_L,R/32 E_C,RR)^(1/4); C_c from (C^-1)_FR = 2 h E_C,FR / e^2 in the small-coupling limit
coupling_capacitance_implied_by_the_sour.note: what the seed geometry would have to realise to reproduce g = 0.150 GHz; it is a suitability reference, not a design target

seed_gap_plausibility_check.method: parallel-plate over the 100 um facing width with an effective 100 um fringe extent, half-space permittivity (1 + 11.45)/2, 20 um gap
seed_gap_plausibility_check.statement: The crude estimate exceeds the 7.2 fF implied by the source-bound g by about 4x, so the declared 20 um coupling gap is expected to over-couple. It is a seed, not a design: the extraction measures what the geometry realises and the suitability report compares it. A wider gap would reduce both the coupling and the mesh cost, but changing the seed is a human decision and is NOT made here.
seed_gap_plausibility_check.classification: ENGINEERING-SEED plausibility estimate, unapproved; order of magnitude only
